title: OCaml Temporal native client update-with-start request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge, submitted with the UPDATE_WITH_START client call selector (#1151). The start document is embedded unchanged and every conflict policy is forwarded. The update never names a run: Temporal resolves the run the start creates or attaches to. The start's rpc_timeout_ms bounds the whole call, including re-issued attempts while the update is only admitted (default 30 seconds). The success value is client-update-with-start-outcome.schema.json. Runtime validators also reject duplicate keys, NUL bytes, and strings over the 65,536-byte safety limit.
